name: codex
title: Codex
description: Browse, search, and jump to your Codex Desktop threads. See which threads are actively running, open them directly in Codex, copy deep links, and navigate to project directories — all from Raycast.
author: ysnows

commands.name: search-threads
commands.title: Search Codex Threads
commands.description: Browse and search your local Codex threads. Open in the Codex app, copy IDs, or open the rollout JSONL.

commands.name: running-threads
commands.title: Show Running Codex Threads
commands.description: Live list of Codex threads with recent activity (based on logs in the last 60 seconds).

preferences.name: codexHome
preferences.title: Codex Home
preferences.description: Path to your Codex data dir. Defaults to ~/.codex

preferences.name: runningWindowSeconds
preferences.title: Running Window (seconds)
preferences.description: How recent log activity counts as 'running'.

preferences.name: includeArchived
preferences.title: Include Archived
preferences.label: Show archived threads in search
preferences.description: When enabled, archived threads are included in the search list.
